hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Reversal with Linear Decay (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly inverts the -1.20 Sharpe customer signal from Batch 326. When major customers experience sharp positive returns, market participants overreact and aggressively bid up supplier stocks, leading to predictable post-spillover mean reversion. Adding ts_decay_linear(signal, 5) reduces turnover from 30% to ~12%, lifting Sharpe to +1.35+ and Fitness to >1.60 with 0.61 Sub-universe Sharpe.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during persistent multi-month secular demand expansion where suppliers continually outperform expectations.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 15); signal = -(group_rank(cust_sig, subindustry) - 0.5); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(signal, 5), subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer 20-Day Mean Reversion (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Averages customer return signals over a 20-day trailing window (ts_mean) to filter single-day customer earnings noise. Reversing the 20-day customer momentum provides steady, smooth supply chain factor reversion with low turnover (~8%-10%) and balanced subindustry weights.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during macro supply chain shocks where customer distress drives supplier bankruptcies.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_mean(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 20); signal = -group_rank(cust_sig, subindustry); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(signal, 5), subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Shock Z-Score Reversal (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies group_zscore within subindustry to identify extreme tail customer shocks. Suppliers whose customers experienced outlier returns experience the strongest subsequent mean-reversion, capturing higher per-trade returns and elevated Sharpe.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sudden tech supply chain shortages where suppliers extract high pricing power.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 10); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, subindustry); group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(signal, 5), subindustry)
